plugin.name: 3D text
plugin.description: 3D letters and numbers in many free fonts (sans serif, serif, display, script, pixel …) or your own TTF/OTF/WOFF files, flat or upright, filled, extruded or as an outline. Brings s3d.text3d() for scripts.
plugin.apiDescription: 3D letters and numbers. size = letter height, depth = extrusion (0 = flat), upright = standing upright (default), filled: false = outline only, "\n" = new line. Fonts (font): {fonts} or your own (“eigene:name”).
